new_findings.title: A native return that explicitly fails semantic review is still accepted and can produce a private locale package
evidence: video/freeform_chapter_pipeline_v1/current_locale.py:33-58 verifies request, role, and source bindings but never reads artifact.semantic_review.
video/freeform_chapter_pipeline_v1/current_locale.py:77-152 validates structure and selected numeric anchors, which cannot establish full translation meaning.
video/freeform_chapter_pipeline_v1/current_locale.py:253-266 emits a generic translation_semantic_review claim independent of the returned semantic decision.
.task-runtime/goal40/native-returns/retail-es-editorial-closure.json:344-346 contains the actual PASS semantic-review result and request hash that the builder currently ignores.

Independent negative probe: changing only artifact.semantic_review.result in a temporary bound-return copy to FAIL_MATERIAL_TRANSLATION_MEANING still returned PRIVATE_CURRENT_LOCALE_PACKAGE_BUILT on the idempotent path.
new_findings.impact: The deterministic builder can package text that its assigned editorial role expressly rejected for material translation meaning, while reporting a semantic-review label that was not gated on that verdict.
new_findings.required_change: Fail closed unless the native artifact contains the exact allowed semantic PASS result bound to the same request hash and expected prior-return/source closure. Add negative tests for missing and failing semantic review on both fresh and idempotent paths.

new_findings.title: Recovery replay trusts an existing unsealed narration-overrun artifact after checking only job and run IDs
evidence: video/unattended_core_factory_v1/supervisor.py:344-347 accepts an existing narration_overrun when video_job_id and run_id match.
video/unattended_core_factory_v1/supervisor.py:348-364 re-derives measurements and invokes immutable comparison only when the file is absent or this is not a replay.
The recovery store event is committed before this artifact and contains no artifact record/hash for it.

Independent negative probe: a temporary existing artifact with the correct job/run IDs, schema tampered-but-id-matching, and duration_seconds 999999 was accepted as an idempotent replay and returned AWAITING_CODEX_DESKTOP_SESSION_INPUT unchanged.
new_findings.impact: Changed or partial local recovery evidence can become the input to the bounded editorial correction without an exact derivation or durable ledger identity, reproducing the same provenance class the correction was intended to close.
new_findings.required_change: On every replay, re-derive the expected artifact from the preserved source WAVs and compare it with _write_immutable_json, including exact schema and all fields. Persist an artifact hash in a recovery-setup event before allowing editorial input, and add an altered-existing-artifact regression test.

new_findings.title: An interrupted successor exposes its new package as current before its matching owner-review-ready record exists
evidence: video/unattended_core_factory_v1/supervisor.py:1924-1942 selects the latest PACKAGE_QA_PASSED globally and does not require a matching OWNER_REVIEW_READY event for the same revision.
video/unattended_core_factory_v1/supervisor.py:2050-2068 intentionally preserves the old OWNER_REVIEW_READY job state while intermediate successor events are appended.
Independent interruption probe after the third PASS produced job_state=OWNER_REVIEW_READY, latest_owner_revision=old, latest_package_revision=new, and current_package_path resolved package_id=new.
tests/test_v2_goal40_recovery_and_captions.py:91-160 proves eventual replay but does not inspect current_package_path between the intermediate commit and retry.
new_findings.impact: During the crash window, subsequent private operations can consume a partially sealed successor even though only the older revision has completed the owner-review-ready boundary.
new_findings.required_change: Resolve current package by a revision-scoped PACKAGE_QA_PASSED plus OWNER_REVIEW_READY pair, or commit a single accepted-revision pointer atomically after all successor records exist. Add an interruption assertion that the old package remains current until the final matching record commits.

new_findings.title: The mux-repair successor remains non-resumable after filesystem creation or an intermediate ledger commit
evidence: video/unattended_core_factory_v1/supervisor.py:2240-2242 rejects every retry once the revision directory exists.
video/unattended_core_factory_v1/supervisor.py:2262-2317 creates the revision artifacts before ledger completion, so a process loss in that interval makes the same revision unrecoverable.
video/unattended_core_factory_v1/supervisor.py:2318-2361 invalidates three old stages, then appends replacement stages via _append one by one.

video/unattended_core_factory_v1/supervisor.py:732-769 passes each intermediate stage as state_pointer; video/unattended_core_factory_v1/store.py:1382-1394 converts those nonterminal pointers to durable RUNNING.
No focused test exercises repair_mux_package or interruption at its filesystem and ledger boundaries.
new_findings.impact: A crash can leave the only job RUNNING or without a current package/owner-review stage while the existing revision directory permanently blocks deterministic retry.
new_findings.required_change: Make mux repair an idempotent immutable successor: validate and reuse exact existing artifacts, preserve OWNER_REVIEW_READY through intermediate appends, and expose the repaired revision only after its final paired boundary. Add crash tests after root creation, each invalidation, and each PASS append.

decision_basis: The exact correction bindings and current artifact closures match, and the focused tests pass, but the four actionable fail-closed and crash-consistency defects above remain in the bound implementation. Scoped acceptance is therefore not supportable.
